patch_description: This replaces the direct-demand-plus-generic-path-reward model with a demand-conditioned transit-fit model. For each origin–destination pair, it scores candidate two-hop routes according to how strongly the intermediate node is connected to that particular origin and destination, rather than using a broad node-traffic statistic. It also retains a modest direct-link preference and discounts transit choices at nodes with high aggregate traffic. The resulting interactions remain restricted to two-hop paths, keeping the term count within the limit while aiming to make useful routes more prominent in both the best and typical low-energy samples.
